description: This file contains utility functions for evaluating object detection models, including functions to compute average precision, get detections and annotations from data generators, and evaluate model performance via mean Average Precision (mAP). It includes core logic for object detection evaluation, uses external visualization and anchor modules, and is part of the ImageAI Retinanet utility suite.

methods.name: _compute_ap(recall, precision)
methods.description: Calculates the average precision given recall and precision curves.

methods.name: _get_detections(generator, model, score_threshold=0.05, max_detections=100, save_path=None)
methods.description: Generates detection results for each image in the dataset using the model and data generator.

methods.name: _get_annotations(generator)
methods.description: Retrieves ground truth annotations from the data generator.

methods.name: evaluate( generator, model, iou_threshold=0.5, score_threshold=0.05, max_detections=100, save_path=None )
methods.description: Main function to evaluate a dataset with a given model, returning per-class mAPs and average inference time.

ctags.name: evaluate
ctags.signature: ( generator, model, iou_threshold=0.5, score_threshold=0.05, max_detections=100, save_path=None )
